## What this stage covers

Tensors, shapes and broadcasting, autograd, and a training loop written by hand
in PyTorch -- then the same model in Keras, for contrast.
:::

::: {.cwai-card}
## What you will be able to do

Split data into train, validation and test sets, recognise overfitting, and
choose metrics that survive class imbalance.
:::
